# TestSync Lab

Remote software QA agency for SaaS teams. Monthly retainers from $999 USD: manual testing, API testing, Playwright automation, performance checks, and AI product QA (chatbots, RAG, LLM evals).

Delivery is remote from Lahore, Pakistan. Buyers are product and engineering teams worldwide, with primary fit in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. We do not claim a fake local office in those countries.
